title: Coleman Classic Camping Stove $40 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings Warehouse
body:
Deal: Coleman Classic Camping Stove $40 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings Warehouse

[Andry] Showed as $40 for me but then changed to $60 after it detected location to NSW
[ratmanuwu] is it out of stock at your store? I set my store to eastgardens and it shows $40 but if I select an out of stock store it is $60
[martinms] same happened to me, when you add to cart the price drops to $40 for c&c ( I logged in with onepass)
[merriweather] Tested one of these recently; pretty good little unit. High temps are high but you can actually simmer and drop the temp right down unlike every other Coleman stove I’ve ever used which generally offer “hot” and “really (profanity) hot”.
[Caeriam] Agree! Used this unit for a year travelling around the country and it is very good with low temp simmering. Great little cooktop
[Chazzozz] $40 in Nth Launceston store. Had one previously, worked really well. Recommended.
[King Tightarse] Must these use those gas canisters shown in the pictures or can you connect it to a BBQ gas bottle?
[Officewalks] No. I also hoped I can use my gas bottle for Weber for this one. unfortunately, it only connects to propane gas bottle or bottle with 3/8" socket. not usual ones you can swap in Bunnings/Gas station.
[inertia8] Fairly sure you can connect to lpg with an adaptor hose. Costco sell a black version of this stove for $139 and it comes with such a hose. Best to double check in bunnos.
[Officewalks] the adaptor hose in package is the one i tested. it is 3/8..not usual size. I was unable to connect to LPG tank.. However, I am not really expert in gas connection. Maybe there's other way.
[A 1] There's a discussion here regarding the Gasmate version where this adaptor is recommended.
Not sure if that's a suitable solution here but I hope there's a way to do it…?
[JakeyJooJoo] You absolutely can use a regular gas bottle with these, just get an adapter. This is the exact burner I have. I got an adapter for it straight away, and cooked on it most nights for a year. I can't remember exactly the adapter, just asked in bunnings and they helped me out.
The burner is pretty good, only thing that annoyed me was trying to put it on low. It runs super hot, trying to get it on a low or medium setting can be a little tricky, I found myself accidentally turning it off a fair bit when trying to lower the heat, very easy to do. Not a deal breaker though, just a bit fiddly. Would buy it for this price.
[freewhere] What type of adapter? can you plz recommend one?
[bargaino] Yes, of course you can run these from any LPG cylinder.
The thing to note is that unlike your big barbecue, they are designed to run on full unregulated pressure.
[tee123] What about the ccv and cctv. Oh and the ccc rating for power banks.
[Broden] I prefer the ones that attach on top of the gas cylinder. no need to overcomplicate it.
